name: TH13 Hard human-prefix vs opening-only online PPO, normal fresh game evaluation
controls: Twelve fresh paired ordinary Stage1 openings, Hard Reimu, identical host and original. No human input, continue or helper during evaluation.
training_rule: Choose the first four eligible registered suffix attempts in ordinal order and their same-ordinal opening controls. Within each group score all observed complete policy-only sequences, normalize TH13 native clock reward and compute GAE. Then sample min(1536, totals of both arms) decisions per model without replacement using a fixed seed. Same parent, actor/critic and clipping schedule. Keep all 12 attempt outcomes for acquisition-rate reporting.
